# SMAA

Enhanced Subpixel Morphological Antialiasing by Jorge Jimenez et al., MIT license (`LICENSE.txt`).

Source: https://github.com/iryoku/smaa, commit `71c806a838bdd7d517df19192a20f0c61b3ca29d` (2013-11-06).
Files copied unchanged: `SMAA.hlsl`, `LICENSE.txt`, `Textures/AreaTex.h`, `Textures/SearchTex.h`.

Used by the swap post effect `swap_post_effect = smaa` (`src/graphics/shaders/smaa*.xesl`).
